scope: Proposition 4.5 (Rational sphere calculation) of the manuscript “The Hilbert–Smith conjecture in every finite dimension” (preprints/The-Hilbert-Smith-conjecture-in-every-finite-dimension-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 304 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e55fa13f40b4c35a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 23. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For either Gr = Fr or Gr = Er, and for j ≥ 0, Gr(Sj ) ⊗ Q ≃ Gr(pt) ⊗ Q  ⊕ Gr−j(pt) ⊗ Q  . In particular, for the fixed odd integer d, both Fd(Sd) ⊗ Q and Ed(Sd) ⊗ Q are one-dimensional rational vector spaces.
